hero.description: Achieve your health & fitness goals at any stage with expert coaching and proven methods.

about.heading: WE PROVIDE TRAINING AND BEST
about.description: Forgewell was built on a simple idea: a gym should make you measurably stronger, not just tired. Every member starts with a movement assessment, trains under certified coaches, and follows a program that adapts as they progress.

services.heading: OUR
services.description: Six coached disciplines. Pick one or combine them — your coach will structure the split.

items.title: Personal Training
items.description: One-on-one programming with a dedicated coach tracking every lift, every week.

items.title: Strength Exercises
items.description: Progressive strength blocks for hypertrophy, powerlifting, or general performance.

items.title: Cardio Training
items.description: Interval and endurance protocols designed around your resting heart rate and goals.

items.title: CrossFit
items.description: High-intensity functional workouts scaled to every fitness level, coached in small groups.

items.title: Yoga
items.description: Mobility and breathwork sessions that speed recovery and protect against injury.

items.title: Nutrition Guidance
items.description: Macro planning and meal strategy built around your training load, not fad diets.

membership.heading: CHOOSE YOUR
membership.description: Cancel or upgrade anytime. No lock-in contracts.

plans.name: Basic
plans.shortDescription: Full gym access, locker room, group classes twice a week, and app-based workout tracking.

plans.name: Standard
plans.shortDescription: Everything in Basic plus unlimited group classes, monthly check-ins, and nutrition guidance.

plans.name: Premium
plans.shortDescription: Full access with weekly personal training, custom programming, and recovery suite.

steps.title: Choose Your Plan
steps.description: Pick the membership tier that matches how often you'll train and the support you need.

steps.title: Register
steps.description: Book a movement assessment so your coach understands your starting point and any limitations.

steps.title: Start Training
steps.description: Begin your first programmed block with a coach guiding form, load, and recovery.

steps.title: Achieve Your Goals
steps.description: Track measurable progress every month and adjust the program as you get stronger.
